settings.label: Squelch
settings.explanation: Sets how readily the receiver opens for a signal.

recommendation.rationale: Start low and raise only enough to quiet local noise.
recommendation.scenarios: Initial local voice listening; adjust at your location.
recommendation.tradeoffs: Too high can hide weak signals; too low can produce noise.

settings.default_evidence: Not established from the reviewed manual; not read from your radio.

settings.label: Power save
settings.explanation: Cycles receiver activity to reduce battery use.

recommendation.rationale: Favor hearing the beginning of incoming calls.
recommendation.scenarios: Listening-first setup with adequate battery power.
recommendation.tradeoffs: Shorter battery runtime; enable when endurance matters more.

settings.default_evidence: Not established from the reviewed manual; not read from your radio.

settings.label: VOX
settings.explanation: Allows sound to trigger transmission without pressing PTT.

recommendation.rationale: Keep transmit activation deliberate while learning.
recommendation.tradeoffs: Hands-free VOX users need separate sensitivity/accessory testing; off is not a transmit lock.

settings.default_evidence: Not established from the reviewed manual; not read from your radio.

settings.label: Transmit time-out timer

recommendation.rationale: Use a finite starting limit rather than unlimited PTT time.
recommendation.scenarios: Short conversational transmissions and initial practice.
recommendation.tradeoffs: Can cut off a long transmission; coordinate with net/repeater procedures. Not a substitute for safe operation.

settings.default_evidence: Not established from the reviewed manual; not read from your radio.

settings.label: Roger tone
settings.explanation: Adds an over-the-air indication when a transmission ends.

recommendation.rationale: Avoid adding an unnecessary transmitted tone.
recommendation.tradeoffs: No end-of-transmission tone; follow local operating preferences.

settings.default_evidence: Not established from the reviewed manual; not read from your radio.

settings.label: Key beep
settings.explanation: Provides audible feedback when using the keys.

recommendation.rationale: Provide confirmation while becoming familiar with the controls.
recommendation.scenarios: Guided setup; operators who benefit from audible feedback.
recommendation.tradeoffs: Can disturb quiet environments; turn off if unwanted. Not a full accessibility solution.

settings.default_evidence: Not established from the reviewed manual; not read from your radio.

settings.label: Backlight timeout
settings.explanation: Controls how long the display stays lit after use.

recommendation.rationale: Allow time to read the display without leaving it permanently lit.
recommendation.scenarios: Everyday handheld setup with occasional screen checks.
recommendation.tradeoffs: Longer lighting uses more battery. Choose longer for readability if needed.

settings.default_evidence: Not established from the reviewed manual; not read from your radio.

limitations: Confirm the exact model and firmware manually; this page cannot detect either.
Values describe a plan, not current radio state, factory defaults or successful programming.
No device connection, radio writes, CPS format or radio-wide CHIRP CSV export is implemented.
Session-only: leaving or reloading discards this plan. Channel drafts and backup v1 exclude it.
Backlight options are a reviewed subset, not an exhaustive hardware claim.
Scan, dual watch, VOX gain/delay, global power and other dependent settings are not modeled here.
